mapper.sql: cp.id, cp.brand_id, br.code AS brand_code, cp.base_currency_id, bc.code AS base_currency_code, cp.quote_currency_id, qc.code AS quote_currency_code, cp.rate, cp.rate_type, cp.active, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at
FROM currency_pair cp JOIN brand br ON br.id = cp.brand_id JOIN currency bc ON bc.id = cp.base_currency_id JOIN currency qc ON qc.id = cp.quote_currency_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO currency_pair (brand_id, base_currency_id, quote_currency_id, rate, rate_type, active) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{baseCurrencyId}, #{quoteCurrencyId}, #{rate}, #{rateType}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE currency_pair SET brand_id = #{brandId}, base_currency_id = #{baseCurrencyId}, quote_currency_id = #{quoteCurrencyId}, rate = #{rate}, rate_type = #{rateType}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
